To compare models fit to the same data by Bayesian inference,
we need a measure that balances goodness of fit against complexity,
as [Akaike's information criterion](https://morrison-lab.github.io/rme/chapters/Linear-models-overview.html#def-aic)
does for models fit by maximum likelihood.
The standard criterion computed from MCMC output
is the deviance information criterion
[@dobson4e, Chapter 13, p. 306].
